seats.findings:
🔴 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js divides by 1000 instead of 10000, so tax is 10x too large (also breaks checkoutTotal and invoiceLine); change `/ 1000` to `/ 10000`
🔴 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js divides by 1000 instead of 100, so the discount is 10x too small (also breaks checkoutTotal); change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
🔴 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/split.js uses `i <= rem`, giving rem+1 shares an extra cent so shares sum to total+1 whenever rem>0; change to `i < rem`
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js uses `qty > 10` so qty 10 gets no bulk discount; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [clamp-max] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js caps at 98 instead of 99; change `Math.min(98, ...)` to `Math.min(99, ...)`
🟠 [cap-discount] MUST-FIX src/cap.js caps at ceil(subtotal/2)+1 instead of floor(subtotal/2), allowing more than 50 percent; use `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX src/fee.js adds 3 cents instead of 30; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [points-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js uses Math.round so 150 cents yields 2 points instead of 1; change to `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
🟠 [min-order-inclusive] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js uses `cents > 1000` so exactly 1000 is rejected; change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-floor] MUST-FIX src/refund.js uses Math.min(100, fee) making 100 the maximum fee instead of the minimum; change to `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))`
🟠 [ship-started-block] MUST-FIX src/ship.js uses Math.floor for the extra 500 g blocks so 1001 g costs 500 instead of 600 ("each started" block must count); change to `Math.ceil(extra / 500)`

🟠 [bulk-gt-not-ge] MUST-FIX bulkCents uses `qty > 10` so qty=10 gets no discount; spec says 10 or more is 10% off (e.g. 10×100¢ → 1000¢ instead of 900¢); change condition to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX couponCents divides by 1000 instead of 100, making discounts 10× too small (subtotal 10000, pct 10 → 100¢ instead of 1000¢) and propagating into checkoutTotal; change `/1000` to `/100`
🟠 [tax-div-1000] MUST-FIX taxCents divides by 1000 instead of 10000, making tax 10× too large (amount 10000, rateBp 1000 → 10000¢ instead of 1000¢) and propagating into checkoutTotal and invoiceLine; change `/1000` to `/10000`
🟠 [clamp-max-98] MUST-FIX clampQty clamps to 98 not 99, so valid qty 99 is reduced to 98; change `Math.min(98, ...)` to `Math.min(99, ...)`
🟠 [cap-ceil-plus-one] MUST-FIX capDiscount uses `Math.ceil(subtotal/2)+1` instead of `Math.floor(subtotal/2)`, allowing discounts above the 50% cap (subtotal 100 → cap 52 instead of 50); use `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal/2))`
🟠 [split-remainder-off-by-one] MUST-FIX splitCents adds +1 for `i <= rem` (0-indexed) giving rem+1 extra cents, so shares overshoot the total (10¢ into 3 → [4,4,4]=12¢); use `i < rem`
🟠 [ship-floor-not-ceil] MUST-FIX shippingCents uses `Math.floor(extra/500)` so a started-but-incomplete 500g segment is free (weight 1001 → 500¢ instead of 600¢ per "each started additional 500 g"); use `Math.ceil(extra/500)`
🟠 [loyalty-round-not-floor] MUST-FIX pointsFor uses Math.round instead of rounding down per full 100¢ (150¢ → 2 points instead of 1); use `Math.floor(cents/100)`
🟠 [minorder-strict-gt] MUST-FIX meetsMinimum uses `cents > 1000` but spec requires at least 1000, so exactly-1000¢ orders are rejected; change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-caps-fee-not-refund] MUST-FIX refundCents caps the fee at 100 instead of flooring the refund at 100, over-refunding large payments (paid 10000 → 9900 instead of 9500); compute `paid - Math.round(paid*0.05)` then floor the refund at 100 without going below 0
🟠 [fee-fixed-3] MUST-FIX cardFeeCents adds a fixed 3 cents instead of 30 (amount 1000 → 59 instead of 59... 29+30=59 vs 29+3=32); change `+ 3` to `+ 30`

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX bulkCents uses `qty > 10` but spec says "10 or more"; qty=10 gets no discount. Change to `qty >= 10`.
🟠 [cap-rounding] MUST-FIX capDiscount uses `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` instead of `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`; returns a value above 50% for every input. Replace with `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`.
🟠 [clamp-upper] MUST-FIX clampQty caps at 98 (`Math.min(98, ...)`) but spec says range 1..99 inclusive. Change 98 to 99.
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX couponCents divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing discounts 10× too small. Change `/1000` to `/100`.
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX cardFeeCents adds fixed 3 cents instead of spec's 30 cents. Change `+ 3` to `+ 30`.
🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX pointsFor uses Math.round but spec says "one point per full 100 cents (round down)"; e.g. 150 cents yields 2 instead of 1. Use Math.floor.
🟠 [minorder-boundary] MUST-FIX meetsMinimum uses `cents > 1000` but spec says "at least 1000"; 1000 cents returns false. Change to `>=`.
🟠 [refund-logic] MUST-FIX refundCents caps the fee at 100 (`Math.min(100, ...)`) instead of ensuring the refund is at least 100 cents per spec; also misinterprets the constraint. Replace with `Math.max(0, Math.max(100, paidCents - Math.round(paidCents * 0.05)))` or equivalent.
🟠 [ship-ceil] MUST-FIX shippingCents uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)` for additional blocks but spec says "each started additional 500 g" (ceiling); 1001 g returns 500 instead of 600. Use `Math.ceil`.
🟠 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX splitCents uses `i <= rem` distributing rem+1 extra cents; sum exceeds total by 1 (e.g. splitCents(10,3) sums to 11). Change to `i < rem`.
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX taxCents divides by 1000 instead of spec's 10000, producing tax 10× too large. Change `/1000` to `/10000`.
🟠 [minorder-off-by-one] MUST-FIX meetsMinimum uses `cents > 1000`, so an order of exactly 1000 cents is rejected although the spec says "at least 1000 cents"; change the comparison to `cents >= 1000`

🟠 [minorder-at-least-1000] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js uses `cents > 1000` but the spec says meetsMinimum is true when the order is at least 1000 cents, so a valid 1000-cent order is rejected at the minimum-order gate; impact is wrongly refused checkouts at exactly the threshold; smallest remediation is changing the comparison to `cents >= 1000`
🔵 [email-boundary-dot-reading] CUT/FOLLOW-UP isEmail rejects domains like "a.b." or ".a.b" while a strict existential reading of "a dot that is not its first or last character" could accept them; both readings agree on all single-dot domains the spec targets, so this ambiguity is excluded from the current version
🔵 [chunk-zero-size-guard] CUT/FOLLOW-UP chunkArray hangs if n is 0 (i += 0 never advances); the spec only defines chunking for length n ≥ 1, so adding a guard is optional hardening excluded from this version

🟠 [minorder-off-by-one] MUST-FIX meetsMinimum uses `cents > 1000` but the spec requires true when the order is "at least 1000 cents" (i.e. >=); an order of exactly 1000 cents incorrectly returns false. Fix: change to `cents >= 1000`.
🟠 [invoice-format] MUST-FIX invoiceLine returns the arithmetic sum `amount + tax` as a single number, but the spec format is "label: amount+tax" with both values shown (e.g. "Widget: 1000+150"); "both in integer cents" confirms two separate values in the output. Fix: return `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``.
